stories.title: Struggling Flintshire families must pay for Holiday Hunger replacement scheme
stories.summary: Families facing food poverty through the summer holidays will now have to pay for the support they receive from Flintshire County Council. With the school summer holidays already underway, the authority has now revealed how it has replaced its Holiday Hunger scheme. stories.title: Chester Zoo breeding programme returns near extinct snails to Desertas islands
stories.summary: Chester Zoo has returned 300 snails to a cliff face in the Atlantic, all of them descended from 21 survivors found clinging to life beneath a single rock. stories.title: Met Office provisional figures put Wales on course for driest July since 1836
stories.summary: Wales is on course for its driest July in 190 years of records and its warmest July on record, according to provisional Met Office figures published on Friday. stories.title: Funded childcare for all Flintshire two-year-olds by March 2027
stories.summary: Every two-year-old in Flintshire is due to qualify for 12.5 hours a week of funded childcare by the end of March 2027, ending the county’s postcode system.
